description: Bounded public disposition for Alice workhorse packaging: an OpenAI-compatible local server with one-command start/stop/status, health checks, logs, and agent-harness integration, running the base checkpoint at its native 262144 context with q8_0 KV in host RAM. The artifact carries no tokenizer chat template, so it is a completion endpoint, not an instruction-tuned agent model. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base (custom alice_ai hybrid KDA linear-attention + MoE)
model_revision: base checkpoint; no post-trained chat behaviour is claimed
model_download_source: public base checkpoint exists; no weight payload or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: Q3.9-MIX (52 x Q4_K + 44 x Q3_K expert tensors, trunk q8_0, control f32)
